### Notable Behaviors

- **User 27 (isabellaA)**: Inactive -- zero watchlist entries, no preferences, no resets
- **User 29 (charlottew)**: ALWAYS chooses 'new' on monthly reset (5 consecutive resets), previous_equity fluctuates around $25k
- **User 28 (willt)**: Two 'new' resets in a row, struggling with losses (previous_equity $19.2k then $21k)
- **User 4 (marcusj_trades)**: One bad month (Dec 2025, equity dropped to $22.8k), reset to 'new', then recovered
- **Dark theme**: ~70% of users who set preferences chose dark mode (19 dark vs 6 light)
- **Power users**: Most usage_count on screeners (User 4's "Volatile Movers" at 78 uses, User 1's "High Volume Movers" at 65)
